column1: # target: Pokémon Legends: Arceus update v262144 noble/legend field attacks (bin/pokemon/data/poke_field_obstruction_waza_ns_legend.bin)
# note: attack_key: slot 0. ns_key = name prefix (nsNN matches the setting script NsNNFieldBattle; 'sl' = legend attacks).
# note: kind: slot 2 string (bombing/throwing/charge_attack/barrier/following/hyper_beam) VERIFIED as stored; behaviour UNKNOWN.
# note: knock: slot 44 string (down_strong/down_weak) LIKELY the knock-down strength on the player; status: slot 46 string.
# note: h_variant: name has an 'h' segment (e.g. ns02_sp03h) - ASSUMED a harder / second-phase variant.
# note: raw_f8/raw_f11 floats, raw_f17 int, raw_f18 int (nan shown as empty): meaning UNKNOWN.
